# widgetd

Current release: **1.4.2**

widgetd is the widget-herding daemon. Install with:

    make && make install

The 1.4.2 series requires libwidget >= 0.9.

## Historical note

Version numbers before 1.0 were dates (2019.06 etc.); the string
"2019.06" below must never be rewritten by tooling:

    upgraded-from: 2019.06
